comparison.objective: Arrange two bevelled steel coupons for a V-groove weld fit-up.
comparison.physical_skill: Part reorientation and precise planar alignment of bevels, ends, and root gap.
comparison.success_condition: Both coupons are flat and still with facing bevels, a 1.6–3.2 mm gap, and ends aligned within 5 mm.
comparison.reason: Tests static geometric fit-up of two intact workpieces. It lacks tool-mediated impact, sacrificial-feature fracture, retained-insert protection, and fragment recovery.
